answer: Proof-of-Placement Beaconing.** Each identity must intermittently solve location-bound challenges by physically relaying a signed beacon to nearby peers; agents wander between checkpoints before earning standing. A candidate survives only if its beacon trail crosses a genuine oasis of corroborating nodes and a ridge separating distinct regions on schedule. Attackers pay in continuous travel and hardware presence per identity, not tokens; forged trails fail when corroborators contest coordinates, so each fake account costs a real fielded device and relocation effort.
